name: Slideology (visual-first slides)
summary: One message per slide carried mainly by an image, diagram or big number, with minimal text the audience can grasp in seconds.
title_style: Very short titles, under 6 words; the visual carries the message.

sequence.purpose: Name the talk with a strong image.
Show the trend as a single picture.
One big number with its meaning.
Show the idea as a simple diagram.

pitfalls: Turning a visual slide back into a bullet list.
Decorative images that do not carry the point.
Several messages fighting on one slide.

example.topic: A fictional valley council explaining a rainwater storage plan
outline: Half the river is gone in summer
